# Third-party source

`codex-usage-badge/` preserves the source tree from Mintzz's fork of
[jaykinhoo9/codex-usage-badge](https://github.com/jaykinhoo9/codex-usage-badge),
including its MIT license and upstream documentation.

Codex Monitor is the single install and management experience. Its pinned,
customized macOS runtime is bundled under `../Resources/CodexUsageBadge/` and is
installed, updated, and repaired from Codex Monitor. The Badge helper remains a
managed background process for ChatGPT page injection; users do not install a
separate Badge app.

The original fork repository is retained as an archived history at
[Mintzz666/codex-usage-badge](https://github.com/Mintzz666/codex-usage-badge).
See [`NOTICE.md`](../NOTICE.md) for attribution and customization details.
